<![CDATA[import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Geist_Mono, Instrument_Serif, Inter_Tight } from "next/font/google";
import "./orrery/orrery.css";

const display = Instrument_Serif({
  weight: "400",
  style: ["normal", "italic"],
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-instrument-serif",
});
const body = Inter_Tight({ subsets: ["latin"], variable: "--font-inter-tight" });
const mono = Geist_Mono({ subsets: ["latin"], variable: "--font-geist-mono" });

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Orrery — the orchestration layer for teams of AI agents",
  description:
    "Orrery coordinates specialised AI agents the way a clockwork orrery moves its planets: each on its own orbit, all in time.",
};

export default function OrreryLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={`${display.variable} ${body.variable} ${mono.variable}`}>
      <body className="orr-body">{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(orrery)/orrery/assets.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { ASSETS } from "./assets.generated";

const BASE = "/templates/orrery";

/** URL for a processed image, or null when the owner hasn't generated it yet. */
export function assetSrc(key: string, width: 800 | 1600, format: "webp" | "avif" = "webp"): string | null {
  return key in ASSETS ? `${BASE}/${key}-${width}.${format}` : null;
}

type PictureProps = {
  assetKey: string;
  alt: string;
  className?: string;
  sizes?: string;
  priority?: boolean;
};

/** A responsive <picture>, or a labelled placeholder block until the image exists. */
export function Picture({ assetKey, alt, className, sizes = "(min-width: 900px) 50vw, 100vw", priority }: PictureProps) {
  const webp800 = assetSrc(assetKey, 800);
  if (!webp800) {
    return (
      <div className={`orr-placeholder ${className ?? ""}`} role="img" aria-label={alt} data-asset={assetKey}>
        <span className="orr-label">{assetKey}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const { w, h } = ASSETS[assetKey];
  const set = (format: "webp" | "avif") => `${assetSrc(assetKey, 800, format)} 800w, ${assetSrc(assetKey, 1600, format)} 1600w`;
  return (
    <picture className={className}>
      <source type="image/avif" srcSet={set("avif")} sizes={sizes} />
      <img
        src={webp800}
        srcSet={set("webp")}
        sizes={sizes}
        width={w}
        height={h}
        alt={alt}
        loading={priority ? "eager" : "lazy"}
        decoding="async"
        data-asset={assetKey}
      />
    </picture>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(orrery)/orrery/orrery.css">
<![CDATA[@import "tailwindcss";

/* ───────────────────────── Orrery design tokens ───────────────────────── */
@theme {
  --color-ink: #0E0F13;
  --color-bone: #F2EFE8;
  --color-ultramarine: #2F3BFF;
  --color-amber: #FFB000;

  --font-display: var(--font-instrument-serif), "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-inter-tight), system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;

  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --ease-deck: cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1);
}

:root {
  --ink-muted: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ink) 62%, var(--color-bone));
  --ink-line: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ink) 16%, var(--color-bone));
  --bone-muted: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-bone) 62%, var(--color-ink));
  --bone-line: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-bone) 18%, var(--color-ink));
  --gutter: clamp(20px, 5vw, 80px);
  --topbar: 76px;
  --deck-duration: 700ms;
}

/* ───────────────────────── Base ───────────────────────── */
.orr-body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--color-bone);
  color: var(--color-ink);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

.orr-body ::selection {
  background: var(--color-ultramarine);
  color: var(--color-bone);
}

.orr-body :focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-ultramarine);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* ───────────────────────── Type ───────────────────────── */
.orr-display {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(3.5rem, min(11vw, 17vh), 11.5rem);
  line-height: 0.88;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  margin: 0;
}

.orr-h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(2.75rem, min(6.2vw, 9vh), 6.75rem);
  line-height: 0.95;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin: 0;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.orr-h2 em,
.orr-display em {
  font-style: italic;
}

/* Explicit headline lines never re-wrap, so the fallback font can't change the line count (no layout shift). */
.orr-line {
  display: block;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.orr-h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.2vw, 2.25rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
  margin: 0;
}

.orr-lead {
  font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.35vw, 1.375rem);
  line-height: 1.5;
  max-width: 34ch;
  margin: 0;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.orr-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.orr-accent {
  color: var(--color-ultramarine);
}

/* ───────────────────────── Top bar ───────────────────────── */
.orr-topbar {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0 0 auto 0;
  z-index: 20;
  height: var(--topbar);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 var(--gutter);
  pointer-events: none;
  color: var(--topbar-color, var(--color-ink));
  background: var(--topbar-bg, var(--color-bone));
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--topbar-line, var(--ink-line));
  transition:
    color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.orr-topbar > * {
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.orr-logo {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.875rem;
  line-height: 1;
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.orr-logo span {
  color: var(--color-ultramarine);
}

.orr-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  height: 44px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  color: inherit;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 160ms var(--ease-out);
}

.orr-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.97);
}

.orr-btn--solid {
  background: var(--color-ultramarine);
  border-color: var(--color-ultramarine);
  color: var(--color-bone);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .orr-btn:hover {
    background: var(--color-ink);
    border-color: var(--color-ink);
    color: var(--color-bone);
  }
  [data-tone="ink"] .orr-btn:hover,
  .orr-topbar[data-tone="ink"] .orr-btn:hover {
    background: var(--color-bone);
    border-color: var(--color-bone);
    color: var(--color-ink);
  }
  .orr-btn--solid:hover {
    background: var(--color-ink);
    border-color: var(--color-ink);
  }
}

.orr-topbar[data-tone="ink"] {
  --topbar-color: var(--color-bone);
  --topbar-bg: var(--color-ink);
  --topbar-line: var(--bone-line);
}

/* ───────────────────────── Deck ───────────────────────── */
.orr-deck {
  position: relative;
}

.orr-slide {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 100svh;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: calc(var(--topbar) + 24px) var(--gutter) 88px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--color-bone);
  color: var(--color-ink);
}

.orr-slide[data-tone="ink"] {
  background: var(--color-ink);
  color: var(--color-bone);
}

.orr-slide-inner {
  flex: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr));
  column-gap: 24px;
  row-gap: 32px;
  align-content: center;
}

.orr-eyebrow {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.orr-slide[data-tone="ink"] .orr-eyebrow {
  color: var(--bone-muted);
}

.orr-eyebrow::before {
  content: "";
  width: 28px;
  height: 1px;
  background: currentColor;
}

/* Counter + chapter rail (colours follow the active slide's tone) */
.orr-counter {
  position: fixed;
  left: var(--gutter);
  bottom: 24px;
  z-index: 20;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink-line);
  background: var(--color-bone);
  color: var(--color-ink);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  transition:
    color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

@media (max-width: 599px) {
  .orr-counter {
    display: none;
  }
}

.orr-counter[data-tone="ink"] {
  background: var(--color-ink);
  border-color: var(--bone-line);
  color: var(--color-bone);
}

.orr-rail {
  position: fixed;
  right: var(--gutter);
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 20;
  display: none;
  --rail-fg: var(--color-ink);
  --rail-muted: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ink) 34%, var(--color-bone));
}

.orr-rail[data-tone="ink"] {
  --rail-fg: var(--color-bone);
  --rail-muted: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-bone) 34%, var(--color-ink));
}

.orr-rail ol {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}

.orr-rail button {
  all: unset;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 28px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--rail-muted);
  transition: color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.orr-rail button span {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(6px);
  transition:
    opacity 200ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 200ms var(--ease-out);
}

.orr-rail button::after {
  content: "";
  width: 14px;
  height: 1px;
  background: currentColor;
  transition: width 240ms var(--ease-out);
}

.orr-rail button[aria-current="step"] {
  color: var(--rail-fg);
}

.orr-rail button[aria-current="step"] span,
.orr-rail:hover button span,
.orr-rail button:focus-visible span {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

.orr-rail:hover button {
  color: var(--rail-fg);
}

.orr-rail button[aria-current="step"]::after {
  width: 34px;
}

/* Desktop keynote mode: slides stack in place and wipe in. */
/* KEYNOTE: keep in sync with KEYNOTE_QUERY in deck/Deck.tsx */
@media (min-width: 900px) and (min-height: 760px) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  html:has(.orr-deck) {
    overflow: hidden;
    overscroll-behavior: none;
  }

  .orr-deck {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .orr-slide {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    will-change: clip-path, transform;
    transition:
      clip-path var(--deck-duration) var(--ease-deck),
      transform var(--deck-duration) var(--ease-deck);
  }

  .orr-deck:not([data-ready]) .orr-slide {
    transition: none;
  }

  .orr-slide[data-state="past"] {
    z-index: 1;
    clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
    transform: translateY(-7vh);
  }

  .orr-slide[data-state="active"] {
    z-index: 2;
    clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
    transform: none;
  }

  .orr-slide[data-state="future"] {
    z-index: 3;
    clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0);
    transform: none;
  }

  .orr-rail {
    display: block;
  }

  /* Keynote mode: transparent bar, and room on the right for the chapter rail. */
  .orr-topbar {
    --topbar-bg: transparent;
    --topbar-line: transparent;
  }

  .orr-slide {
    padding-right: calc(var(--gutter) + 150px);
  }
}

/* ───────────────────────── Shared slide pieces ───────────────────────── */
.orr-placeholder {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 14px, color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 5%, transparent) 14px 15px),
    color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 4%, transparent);
  border: 1px dashed color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 28%, transparent);
  color: inherit;
}

.orr-placeholder .orr-label {
  opacity: 0.6;
  align-self: start;
  justify-self: start;
  padding: 12px 14px;
}

.orr-art {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.orr-art img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.orr-art--title {
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3.4;
}

.orr-art--portrait {
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
}

.orr-art--card {
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
}

kbd {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.85em;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

/* Mobile/flow default: every block spans the full width. */
.orr-slide-inner > * {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  min-width: 0;
}

/* ───────────────────────── 01 Title ───────────────────────── */
.orr-title__copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 28px;
}

.orr-title__kicker {
  color: var(--color-ultramarine);
}

.orr-title__actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
}

.orr-title__art {
  margin: 0;
}

.orr-title__hint {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  display: none;
}

/* ───────────────────────── 02 Problem ───────────────────────── */
.orr-problem__art {
  margin: 0;
}

.orr-problem__copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 40px;
}

.orr-numbered {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ink-line);
}

.orr-numbered li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 20px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink-line);
}

.orr-numbered__n {
  color: var(--color-ultramarine);
  padding-top: 4px;
}

.orr-numbered__title {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  margin: 0 0 4px;
}

.orr-numbered p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  max-width: 46ch;
}

/* ───────────────────────── 03 The orrery ───────────────────────── */
.orr-orrery__copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 36px;
}

.orr-legend {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}

.orr-legend li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 9.5rem 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: baseline;
  transition: opacity 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.orr-legend li[data-lit="off"] {
  opacity: 0.28;
}

.orr-legend .orr-label {
  color: var(--color-bone);
}

.orr-legend li:last-child .orr-label {
  color: var(--color-amber);
}

.orr-legend p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--bone-muted);
  font-size: 0.975rem;
}

.orr-orrery__diagram {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}

.orr-orbit {
  width: min(100%, 64vh, 620px);
  height: auto;
  overflow: visible;
}

.orr-orbit [data-show] {
  transition:
    opacity 500ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 500ms var(--ease-out),
    stroke-dashoffset 900ms var(--ease-out);
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.orr-orbit [data-show="off"] {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.6);
}

.orr-orbit__ring {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--bone-line);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  stroke-dasharray: 1;
  stroke-dashoffset: 0;
}

.orr-orbit__ring[data-show="off"] {
  stroke-dashoffset: 1;
  transform: none;
}

.orr-orbit__ring--outer {
  stroke-dasharray: 0.006 0.008;
}

.orr-orbit__links line {
  stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-bone) 32%, var(--color-ink));
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.orr-orbit__links[data-show="off"] {
  transform: none;
}

.orr-orbit__agent {
  fill: var(--color-bone);
}

.orr-orbit__agent--accent {
  fill: var(--color-ultramarine);
}

.orr-orbit__core {
  fill: var(--color-bone);
}

.orr-orbit__pulse circle {
  fill: var(--color-amber);
}

/* ───────────────────────── 04 How it works ───────────────────────── */
.orr-steps {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
}

.orr-steps__item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 28px 0 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-ink);
}

.orr-steps__n {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 4.5rem;
  line-height: 0.8;
  color: var(--color-ultramarine);
}

.orr-steps__item p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  max-width: 34ch;
}

/* ───────────────────────── 05 Use cases ───────────────────────── */
.orr-cases__list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 32px;
}

.orr-cases__item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}

.orr-cases__item p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.975rem;
}


/* ───────────────────────── 06 Results ───────────────────────── */
.orr-results__grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 32px;
}

.orr-figure {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-ink);
  padding-top: 20px;
}

.orr-figure__value {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(4.5rem, min(9vw, 13vh), 9rem);
  line-height: 0.9;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.orr-figure__label {
  margin: 14px 0 0;
  max-width: 26ch;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.orr-results__note {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

/* ───────────────────────── 07 Quotes ───────────────────────── */
.orr-visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.orr-quotes__lead {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 28px;
}

.orr-quotes__texture {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: -6%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: min(42vw, 520px, 58vh); /* capped by height too, so it never hangs past the slide */
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  opacity: 0.22;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.orr-quotes__lead blockquote,
.orr-quotes__lead figcaption {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  margin: 0;
}

.orr-quotes__big {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.8vw, 3.75rem);
  line-height: 1.08;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.orr-quotes figcaption {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

.orr-quotes figcaption .orr-label {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.orr-quotes__name {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.orr-quotes__rest {
  display: grid;
  gap: 28px;
}

.orr-quotes__small {
  margin: 0;
  padding-top: 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ink-line);
}

.orr-quotes__small blockquote {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
}

.orr-quotes__small p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.125rem;
}

/* ───────────────────────── 08 Pricing ───────────────────────── */
.orr-tiers {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.orr-tier {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 28px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink-line);
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.orr-tier[data-featured] {
  background: var(--color-ink);
  color: var(--color-bone);
  border-color: var(--color-ink);
}

.orr-tier__head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.orr-tier__head h3 {
  margin: 0;
}

.orr-tier__badge {
  color: var(--color-amber);
}

.orr-tier__price {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 4.4vw, 4.5rem);
  line-height: 1;
}

.orr-tier__price .orr-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  margin-left: 6px;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.orr-tier[data-featured] .orr-tier__price .orr-label,
.orr-tier[data-featured] .orr-tier__blurb {
  color: var(--bone-muted);
}

.orr-tier__blurb {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.orr-tier__features {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  flex: 1;
}

.orr-tier__features li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.orr-tier__features svg {
  color: var(--color-ultramarine);
  flex: none;
}

.orr-tier[data-featured] .orr-tier__features svg {
  color: var(--color-amber);
}

.orr-tier .orr-btn {
  align-self: flex-start;
}

/* ───────────────────────── 09 Security ───────────────────────── */
.orr-claims {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 0 32px;
}

.orr-claims li {
  padding: 18px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--bone-line);
}

.orr-claims__title {
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
}

.orr-claims p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--bone-muted);
}

.orr-security__texture {
  display: none;
}

/* ───────────────────────── 10 CTA ───────────────────────── */
.orr-cta__copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 28px;
}

.orr-cta__title {
  font-size: clamp(3.5rem, min(8vw, 12vh), 8.5rem);
}

.orr-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 28px;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-ink);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--color-bone);
}

.orr-form--sent {
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 260px;
  align-content: center;
}

.orr-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.orr-field label {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.orr-field input {
  height: 48px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink-line);
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-ink);
  font: inherit;
  transition: border-color 160ms var(--ease-out);
}

.orr-field input:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--color-ultramarine);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-ultramarine);
}

.orr-field[data-invalid] input {
  border-color: var(--color-ink);
}

.orr-field__error {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--color-ultramarine);
}

.orr-form__submit {
  justify-self: start;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

.orr-cta__footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 20px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  padding-top: 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ink-line);
}

.orr-cta__footer a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.orr-cta__footer a:hover {
  color: var(--color-ink);
}

/* ───────────────────────── Desktop layouts ───────────────────────── */
@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .orr-title__copy {
    grid-column: 1 / span 7;
    grid-row: 1;
    align-self: center;
  }
  .orr-title__art {
    grid-column: 8 / -1;
    grid-row: 1;
    align-self: center;
  }
  .orr-title__hint {
    display: block;
    grid-row: 2;
  }

  .orr-problem__art {
    grid-column: 1 / span 4;
    align-self: center;
  }
  .orr-problem__copy {
    grid-column: 6 / -1;
    align-self: center;
  }

  .orr-orrery__copy {
    grid-column: 1 / span 5;
    align-self: center;
  }
  .orr-orrery__diagram {
    grid-column: 6 / -1;
  }
  .orr-orrery .orr-eyebrow {
    grid-row: 1;
  }

  .orr-how__title {
    grid-column: 1 / span 9;
  }
  .orr-steps {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
  }

  .orr-cases__title {
    grid-column: 1 / span 8;
  }
  .orr-cases__list {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
  }

  .orr-results__title {
    grid-column: 1 / span 9;
  }
  .orr-results__grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
  }

  .orr-quotes__lead {
    grid-column: 1 / span 7;
    align-self: center;
  }
  .orr-quotes__rest {
    grid-column: 9 / -1;
    align-self: center;
  }

  .orr-pricing__title {
    grid-column: 1 / span 9;
  }
  .orr-tiers {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }

  .orr-security__title {
    grid-column: 1 / span 7;
  }
  .orr-claims {
    grid-column: 1 / span 8;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
  .orr-security__texture {
    display: block;
    grid-column: 9 / -1;
    grid-row: 2 / span 2;
    align-self: stretch;
    min-height: 100%;
  }
  .orr-security__texture img {
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }

  .orr-cta__copy {
    grid-column: 1 / span 6;
    align-self: center;
  }
  .orr-cta__form {
    grid-column: 8 / -1;
    align-self: center;
  }
}

/* Keynote mode: slide content builds in after the wipe. */
/* KEYNOTE: keep in sync with KEYNOTE_QUERY in deck/Deck.tsx */
@media (min-width: 900px) and (min-height: 760px) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .orr-reveal {
    transition:
      opacity 600ms var(--ease-out),
      transform 600ms var(--ease-out);
    transition-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 80ms + 280ms);
  }
  .orr-slide:not([data-state="active"]) .orr-reveal {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(18px);
    transition-delay: 0ms;
    transition-duration: 200ms;
  }
  /* Before the deck is ready (first paint), don't hide the first slide's content. */
  .orr-deck:not([data-ready]) .orr-reveal {
    transition: none;
  }
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { Logo } from "./brand/Logo";
import { Deck, type Slide } from "./deck/Deck";
import { CtaSlide } from "./slides/CtaSlide";
import { HowSlide } from "./slides/HowSlide";
import { OrrerySlide } from "./slides/OrrerySlide";
import { PricingSlide } from "./slides/PricingSlide";
import { ProblemSlide } from "./slides/ProblemSlide";
import { QuotesSlide } from "./slides/QuotesSlide";
import { ResultsSlide } from "./slides/ResultsSlide";
import { SecuritySlide } from "./slides/SecuritySlide";
import { TitleSlide } from "./slides/TitleSlide";
import { UseCasesSlide } from "./slides/UseCasesSlide";

const SLIDES: Slide[] = [
  { id: "title", chapter: "Orrery", render: () => <TitleSlide /> },
  { id: "problem", chapter: "The problem", render: () => <ProblemSlide /> },
  { id: "orrery", chapter: "The orrery", tone: "ink", render: (active) => <OrrerySlide active={active} /> },
  { id: "how", chapter: "How it works", render: () => <HowSlide /> },
  { id: "use-cases", chapter: "Use cases", render: () => <UseCasesSlide /> },
  { id: "results", chapter: "Results", render: (active) => <ResultsSlide active={active} /> },
  { id: "quotes", chapter: "Customers", render: () => <QuotesSlide /> },
  { id: "pricing", chapter: "Pricing", render: () => <PricingSlide /> },
  { id: "security", chapter: "Security", tone: "ink", render: () => <SecuritySlide /> },
  { id: "cta", chapter: "Book a demo", render: () => <CtaSlide /> },
];

export function OrreryDeck() {
  const [tone, setTone] = useState<"bone" | "ink">("bone");
  const onToneChange = useCallback((t: "bone" | "ink") => setTone(t), []);
  return (
    <>
      <header className="orr-topbar" data-tone={tone}>
        <Logo />
        <a className="orr-btn" href="#cta">
          Book a demo
        </a>
      </header>
      <main>
        <Deck slides={SLIDES} onToneChange={onToneChange} />
      </main>
    </>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA[/** The Orrery wordmark: Instrument Serif with an ultramarine full stop. */
export function Logo({ className = "orr-logo" }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <a href="#title" className={className} aria-label="Orrery, back to the first slide">
      Orrery<span aria-hidden="true">.</span>
    </a>
  );
}

/** The mark: a core inside two orbits with one ultramarine satellite. Also used for icon.svg. */
export function OrreryMark({ size = 32, title }: { size?: number; title?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 32 32" role={title ? "img" : undefined} aria-hidden={title ? undefined : true}>
      {title ? <title>{title}</title> : null}
      <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="13" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.25" />
      <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="7.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.25" />
      <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="2.75" fill="currentColor" />
      <circle cx="25.2" cy="6.8" r="2.6" fill="#2F3BFF" />
    </svg>
  );
}

<![CDATA[export function ChapterRail({
  chapters,
  active,
  tone,
  onSelect,
}: {
  chapters: string[];
  active: number;
  tone: "bone" | "ink";
  onSelect: (index: number) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <nav className="orr-rail" data-tone={tone} aria-label="Chapters">
      <ol>
        {chapters.map((chapter, i) => (
          <li key={chapter}>
            <button type="button" aria-current={i === active ? "step" : undefined} onClick={() => onSelect(i)}>
              <span>{chapter}</span>
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(orrery)/orrery/deck/deck-state.ts">
<![CDATA[export type DeckState = { index: number; count: number };

export type DeckAction =
  | { type: "next" | "prev" | "first" | "last" }
  | { type: "goto"; index: number };

const clamp = (index: number, count: number) => Math.min(count - 1, Math.max(0, index));

export function deckReducer(state: DeckState, action: DeckAction): DeckState {
  const target = (() => {
    switch (action.type) {
      case "next":
        return state.index + 1;
      case "prev":
        return state.index - 1;
      case "first":
        return 0;
      case "last":
        return state.count - 1;
      case "goto":
        return action.index;
    }
  })();
  const index = clamp(target, state.count);
  return index === state.index ? state : { ...state, index };
}

/** "03 / 10" for the third of ten slides. */
export function formatCounter(index: number, count: number): string {
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${pad(index + 1)} / ${pad(count)}`;
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(orrery)/orrery/deck/Deck.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useReducer, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { deckReducer } from "./deck-state";
import { ChapterRail } from "./ChapterRail";
import { SlideCounter } from "./SlideCounter";

export type Slide = {
  id: string;
  chapter: string;
  tone?: "bone" | "ink";
  render: (active: boolean) => ReactNode;
};

/**
 * Keynote mode runs only on screens wide AND tall enough to fit a full slide, without reduced motion.
 * Keep in sync with the two `@media` blocks marked KEYNOTE in orrery.css.
 */
export const KEYNOTE_QUERY = "(min-width: 900px) and (min-height: 760px) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)";
const STEP_LOCK_MS = 650;

export function Deck({ slides, onToneChange }: { slides: Slide[]; onToneChange?: (tone: "bone" | "ink") => void }) {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(deckReducer, { index: 0, count: slides.length });
  // "unknown" until the first effect runs, so neither mode's listeners start against the wrong layout.
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"unknown" | "keynote" | "flow">("unknown");
  const keynote = mode === "keynote";
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const sectionRefs = useRef<(HTMLElement | null)[]>([]);
  const lockedUntil = useRef(0);

  // Track which mode we're in.
  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia(KEYNOTE_QUERY);
    const sync = () => setMode(mq.matches ? "keynote" : "flow");
    sync();
    mq.addEventListener("change", sync);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", sync);
  }, []);

  // Deep links: read the hash on load and whenever it changes (e.g. the "Book a demo" link).
  useEffect(() => {
    const fromHash = () => {
      const i = slides.findIndex((s) => `#${s.id}` === window.location.hash);
      if (i >= 0) dispatch({ type: "goto", index: i });
    };
    fromHash();
    // Enable transitions only after the initial jump, so a deep link doesn't animate through every slide.
    const raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => setReady(true));
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", fromHash);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      window.removeEventListener("hashchange", fromHash);
    };
  }, [slides]);

  const step = useCallback((type: "next" | "prev" | "first" | "last") => {
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now < lockedUntil.current) return;
    lockedUntil.current = now + STEP_LOCK_MS;
    dispatch({ type });
  }, []);

  // Keyboard, wheel and touch drive the deck in keynote mode only.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!keynote) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
      // Typing in a form field must never change slides.
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      if (target?.closest("input, textarea, select, [contenteditable]:not([contenteditable='false'])")) return;
      // Space and Enter on a focused control press that control.
      if ((e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") && target?.closest("button, a[href], summary, [role='button']")) return;
      const map: Record<string, "next" | "prev" | "first" | "last"> = {
        ArrowDown: "next",
        ArrowRight: "next",
        PageDown: "next",
        " ": "next",
        ArrowUp: "prev",
        ArrowLeft: "prev",
        PageUp: "prev",
        Home: "first",
        End: "last",
      };
      const action = map[e.key];
      if (!action) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      dispatch({ type: action });
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);

    let observer: { kill: () => void } | undefined;
    let cancelled = false;
    Promise.all([import("gsap"), import("gsap/Observer")]).then(([{ gsap }, { Observer }]) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      gsap.registerPlugin(Observer);
      observer = Observer.create({
        target: window,
        type: "wheel,touch",
        wheelSpeed: -1,
        tolerance: 12,
        preventDefault: true,
        onUp: () => step("next"),
        onDown: () => step("prev"),
      });
    });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      observer?.kill();
    };
  }, [keynote, step]);

  // Flow mode: the counter follows whichever slide crosses the middle of the viewport (works for tall slides too).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== "flow") return;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            const i = sectionRefs.current.indexOf(entry.target as HTMLElement);
            if (i >= 0) dispatch({ type: "goto", index: i });
          }
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: "-50% 0px -50% 0px", threshold: 0 },
    );
    sectionRefs.current.forEach((el) => el && io.observe(el));
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, [mode]);

  // Keep the hash in sync with the active slide in keynote mode.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!keynote || !ready) return;
    const hash = `#${slides[state.index].id}`;
    if (window.location.hash !== hash) history.replaceState(null, "", hash);
  }, [keynote, ready, state.index, slides]);

  useEffect(() => {
    onToneChange?.(slides[state.index].tone ?? "bone");
  }, [state.index, slides, onToneChange]);

  const goTo = (index: number) => {
    if (keynote) dispatch({ type: "goto", index });
    else {
      const reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
      sectionRefs.current[index]?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduce ? "auto" : "smooth" });
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="orr-deck" data-ready={ready ? "" : undefined}>
        {slides.map((slide, i) => {
          const position = i < state.index ? "past" : i === state.index ? "active" : "future";
          return (
            <section
              key={slide.id}
              id={slide.id}
              ref={(el) => {
                sectionRefs.current[i] = el;
              }}
              className="orr-slide"
              data-tone={slide.tone ?? "bone"}
              data-state={position}
              aria-roledescription="slide"
              aria-label={`${i + 1} of ${slides.length}: ${slide.chapter}`}
              inert={keynote && position !== "active" ? true : undefined}
            >
              {slide.render(i === state.index)}
            </section>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <SlideCounter index={state.index} count={slides.length} tone={slides[state.index].tone ?? "bone"} />
      <ChapterRail
        chapters={slides.map((s) => s.chapter)}
        active={state.index}
        tone={slides[state.index].tone ?? "bone"}
        onSelect={goTo}
      />
    </>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

  return (

    <file path="src/app/(orrery)/orrery/forms/demo-form.ts">
<![CDATA[export type DemoInput = { name: string; email: string; company: string };
export type DemoErrors = Partial<Record<keyof DemoInput, string>>;

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

export function validateDemo(input: DemoInput): DemoErrors {
  const errors: DemoErrors = {};
  if (!input.name.trim()) errors.name = "Add your name";
  if (!EMAIL.test(input.email.trim())) errors.email = "Enter a work email";
  if (!input.company.trim()) errors.company = "Add your company";
  return errors;
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { validateDemo, type DemoErrors, type DemoInput } from "./demo-form";

const FIELDS: { name: keyof DemoInput; label: string; type: string; autoComplete: string }[] = [
  { name: "name", label: "Name", type: "text", autoComplete: "name" },
  { name: "email", label: "Work email", type: "email", autoComplete: "email" },
  { name: "company", label: "Company", type: "text", autoComplete: "organization" },
];

/** Demo request form. Validates in the browser and shows a success state; it never sends anything. */
export function DemoForm() {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<DemoInput>({ name: "", email: "", company: "" });
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<DemoErrors>({});
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);

  const onSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const next = validateDemo(values);
    setErrors(next);
    const firstInvalid = FIELDS.find((f) => next[f.name]);
    if (firstInvalid) {
      formRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(`[name="${firstInvalid.name}"]`)?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setSent(true);
  };

  if (sent) {
    return (
      <div className="orr-form orr-form--sent" role="status">
        <span className="orr-label orr-accent">Request received</span>
        <p className="orr-h3">Thanks — we&apos;ll be in touch within one working day.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form ref={formRef} className="orr-form" onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
      {FIELDS.map((f) => {
        const error = errors[f.name];
        const id = `demo-${f.name}`;
        return (
          <div key={f.name} className="orr-field" data-invalid={error ? "" : undefined}>
            <label htmlFor={id} className="orr-label">
              {f.label}
            </label>
            <input
              id={id}
              name={f.name}
              type={f.type}
              autoComplete={f.autoComplete}
              value={values[f.name]}
              aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-error` : undefined}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setValues((v) => ({ ...v, [f.name]: e.target.value }));
                if (error) setErrors((x) => ({ ...x, [f.name]: undefined }));
              }}
            />
            {error ? (
              <p id={`${id}-error`} className="orr-field__error">
                {error}
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        );
      })}
      <button type="submit" className="orr-btn orr-btn--solid orr-form__submit">
        Book a demo
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(orrery)/orrery/motion/useReducedMotion.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

import {useSyncExternalStore} from "react";

const query="(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)";
const subscribe=(notify:()=>void)=>{
  const media=window.matchMedia(query);
  media.addEventListener("change",notify);
  return()=>media.removeEventListener("change",notify);
};
const clientSnapshot=()=>window.matchMedia(query).matches;
const serverSnapshot=()=>false;

/** Keep SSR and the first hydrated frame identical, then apply the user's preference. */
export function useReducedMotion(){
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe,clientSnapshot,serverSnapshot);
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../motion/useReducedMotion";

export type OrbitStep = 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;
const FINAL: OrbitStep = 4;
const STEP_MS = 450;

const C = 300; // centre of the 600×600 viewBox
const INNER = 128;
const OUTER = 228;

const polar = (r: number, deg: number) => {
  const a = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
  return { x: C + r * Math.cos(a), y: C + r * Math.sin(a) };
};

const INNER_AGENTS = [polar(INNER, -150), polar(INNER, 30)];
const OUTER_AGENTS = [polar(OUTER, -40), polar(OUTER, 95), polar(OUTER, 200)];
const HANDOFF = OUTER_AGENTS[0]; // the ultramarine agent receives the task

/** Advances the build every 450 ms while `active`, like a keynote build. Fully built at once under reduced motion. */
export function useOrbitBuild(active: boolean): OrbitStep {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<OrbitStep>(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce) return;
    if (!active) {
      setStep(0);
      return;
    }
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      setStep((s) => (s >= FINAL ? s : ((s + 1) as OrbitStep)));
    }, STEP_MS);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [active, reduce]);

  return reduce ? FINAL : step;
}

/** Pure SVG. Step 0: core · 1: inner orbit + 2 agents · 2: outer orbit + 3 agents · 3: links · 4: task pulse. */
export function OrbitDiagram({ step }: { step: OrbitStep }) {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const shown = step;
  const on = (n: OrbitStep) => (shown >= n ? "on" : "off");
  const pulsePath = `M ${C} ${C} L ${INNER_AGENTS[1].x} ${INNER_AGENTS[1].y} L ${HANDOFF.x} ${HANDOFF.y}`;

  return (
    <svg
      className="orr-orbit"
      viewBox="0 0 600 600"
      data-orbit-step={shown}
      role="img"
      aria-label="Diagram: a conductor at the centre, two research agents on an inner orbit, three builder agents on an outer orbit, linked by shared memory, with a task passing between them."
    >
      {/* Orbits */}
      <circle className="orr-orbit__ring" data-show={on(1)} cx={C} cy={C} r={INNER} pathLength={1} />
      <circle className="orr-orbit__ring orr-orbit__ring--outer" data-show={on(2)} cx={C} cy={C} r={OUTER} pathLength={1} />

      {/* Links: shared memory */}
      <g className="orr-orbit__links" data-show={on(3)}>
        {[...INNER_AGENTS, ...OUTER_AGENTS].map((p, i) => (
          <line key={i} x1={C} y1={C} x2={p.x} y2={p.y} pathLength={1} />
        ))}
        <line x1={INNER_AGENTS[1].x} y1={INNER_AGENTS[1].y} x2={HANDOFF.x} y2={HANDOFF.y} pathLength={1} />
      </g>

      {/* Inner orbit: researchers */}
      <g className="orr-orbit__spin orr-orbit__spin--inner">
        {INNER_AGENTS.map((p, i) => (
          <circle key={i} className="orr-orbit__agent" data-show={on(1)} cx={p.x} cy={p.y} r={11} />
        ))}
      </g>

      {/* Outer orbit: builders */}
      <g className="orr-orbit__spin orr-orbit__spin--outer">
        {OUTER_AGENTS.map((p, i) => (
          <circle
            key={i}
            className={i === 0 ? "orr-orbit__agent orr-orbit__agent--accent" : "orr-orbit__agent"}
            data-show={on(2)}
            cx={p.x}
            cy={p.y}
            r={i === 0 ? 17 : 9}
          />
        ))}
      </g>

      {/* Conductor */}
      <circle className="orr-orbit__core" data-show="on" cx={C} cy={C} r={30} />

      {/* Task pulse */}
      <g className="orr-orbit__pulse" data-show={on(4)}>
        {reduce ? (
          <circle cx={INNER_AGENTS[1].x} cy={INNER_AGENTS[1].y} r={7} />
        ) : (
          <circle r={7}>
            <animateMotion dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" path={pulsePath} keyPoints="0;1" keyTimes="0;1" calcMode="linear" />
          </circle>
        )}
      </g>
    </svg>
  );
}

export const ORBIT_LEGEND = [
  { step: 0, name: "The conductor", text: "Reads the brief, splits the work and keeps time." },
  { step: 1, name: "Researchers", text: "Close orbit. They gather context and check facts." },
  { step: 2, name: "Builders", text: "Wide orbit. They write, code and produce." },
  { step: 3, name: "Shared memory", text: "Every agent reads from and writes to one record." },
  { step: 4, name: "The hand-off", text: "Work moves between agents, never dropped, always logged." },
] as const;
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../motion/useReducedMotion";
import { Eyebrow, rv } from "./Eyebrow";

const RESULTS = [
  { value: 4.2, decimals: 1, suffix: "×", label: "more tasks finished per week than single-agent setups" },
  { value: 63, decimals: 0, suffix: "%", label: "less time spent reviewing agent output" },
  { value: 99.6, decimals: 1, suffix: "%", label: "of hand-offs logged, replayable and attributable" },
];

const COUNT_MS = 1200;

/** Counts from 0 to `target` with a strong ease-out while `active`; static under reduced motion. */
function useCountUp(target: number, active: boolean) {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const [value, setValue] = useState(target);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce || !active) {
      setValue(target);
      return;
    }
    let raf = 0;
    const start = performance.now();
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / COUNT_MS);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 4);
      setValue(target * eased);
      if (t < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    setValue(0);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [active, reduce, target]);

  return value;
}

function Figure({ value, decimals, suffix, label, active }: (typeof RESULTS)[number] & { active: boolean }) {
  const shown = useCountUp(value, active);
  return (
    <div className="orr-figure">
      <p className="orr-figure__value">
        <span className="orr-visually-hidden">
          {value}
          {suffix}
        </span>
        <span aria-hidden="true">
          {shown.toFixed(decimals)}
          <span className="orr-accent">{suffix}</span>
        </span>
      </p>
      <p className="orr-figure__label">{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ResultsSlide({ active }: { active: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className="orr-slide-inner orr-results">
      <Eyebrow n={6}>Results</Eyebrow>
      <h2 className="orr-h2 orr-results__title orr-reveal" style={rv(1)}>
        Measured in work <em>that ships.</em>
      </h2>
      <div className="orr-results__grid">
        {RESULTS.map((r, i) => (
          <div key={r.label} className="orr-reveal" style={rv(i + 2)}>
            <Figure {...r} active={active} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="orr-label orr-results__note orr-reveal" style={rv(5)}>
        Median across 140 teams in the 2026 pilot programme
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
]]>

          alt="A brass orrery photographed from above, one planet painted ultramarine"
          className="orr-art orr-art--title"
          sizes="(min-width: 900px) 45vw, 100vw"
          priority
        />
      </figure>
      <p className="orr-title__hint orr-label orr-reveal" style={rv(4)}>
        Scroll, or press <kbd>→</kbd>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(orrery)/orrery/slides/UseCasesSlide.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { Picture } from "../assets";
import { Eyebrow, rv } from "./Eyebrow";

const CASES = [
  {
    key: "usecase-1",
    title: "Customer operations",
    text: "Triage, research and reply agents clear the queue overnight. People handle the conversations that need a person.",
    alt: "Index cards connected by fine ultramarine ink lines",
  },
  {
    key: "usecase-2",
    title: "Research and analysis",
    text: "One agent gathers sources, another checks every claim, a third writes the brief your team actually reads.",
    alt: "A brass magnifying lens over a printed star chart",
  },
  {
    key: "usecase-3",
    title: "Software engineering",
    text: "Planning, coding and review agents work the same ticket in turn, and every change arrives with its reasoning.",
    alt: "Brass clock gears on gridded drafting paper",
  },
];

export function UseCasesSlide() {
  return (
    <div className="orr-slide-inner orr-cases">
      <Eyebrow n={5}>Use cases</Eyebrow>
      <h2 className="orr-h2 orr-cases__title orr-reveal" style={rv(1)}>
        Where teams put <em>it to work.</em>
      </h2>
      <ul className="orr-cases__list">
        {CASES.map((c, i) => (
          <li key={c.key} className="orr-cases__item orr-reveal" style={rv(i + 2)}>
            <Picture assetKey={c.key} alt={c.alt} className="orr-art orr-art--card" sizes="(min-width: 900px) 28vw, 100vw" />
            <h3 className="orr-h3">{c.title}</h3>
            <p>{c.text}</p>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

<body class="orr-body"><div id="standalone-root"><header class="orr-topbar" data-tone="bone"><a href="#title" class="orr-logo" aria-label="Orrery, back to the first slide">Orrery<span aria-hidden="true">.</span></a><a class="orr-btn" href="#cta">Book a demo</a></header><main><div class="orr-deck"><section id="title" class="orr-slide" data-tone="bone" data-state="active" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="1 of 10: Orrery"><div class="orr-slide-inner orr-title"><div class="orr-title__copy"><p class="orr-label orr-reveal orr-title__kicker" style="--i:0">The orchestration layer for AI agents</p><h1 class="orr-display orr-reveal" style="--i:1"><span class="orr-line">Many agents,</span><em class="orr-line">one clockwork.</em></h1><p class="orr-lead orr-reveal" style="--i:2">Orrery runs teams of specialised AI agents the way an orrery moves its planets. Each one keeps its own orbit, and all of them stay in time.</p><div class="orr-title__actions orr-reveal" style="--i:3"><a class="orr-btn orr-btn--solid" href="#cta">Book a demo</a><a class="orr-btn" href="#how">How it works <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 256 256" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M224.49,136.49l-72,72a12,12,0,0,1-17-17L187,140H40a12,12,0,0,1,0-24H187L135.51,64.48a12,12,0,0,1,17-17l72,72A12,12,0,0,1,224.49,136.49Z"></path></svg></a></div></div><figure class="orr-title__art orr-reveal" style="--i:2"><picture class="orr-art orr-art--title"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1376" height="768" alt="A brass orrery photographed from above, one planet painted ultramarine" loading="eager" decoding="async" data-asset="title-orbits" data-standalone-src="/templates/orrery/title-orbits-800.webp"/></picture></figure><p class="orr-title__hint orr-label orr-reveal" style="--i:4">Scroll, or press <kbd>→</kbd></p></div></section><section id="problem" class="orr-slide" data-tone="bone" data-state="future" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="2 of 10: The problem"><div class="orr-slide-inner orr-problem"><p class="orr-eyebrow orr-label orr-reveal" style="--i:0">02<!-- --> — <!-- -->The problem</p><figure class="orr-problem__art orr-reveal" style="--i:1"><picture class="orr-art orr-art--portrait"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="896" height="1200" alt="A single brass sphere standing alone on an empty sheet of paper" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-asset="problem-single" data-standalone-src="/templates/orrery/problem-single-800.webp"/></picture></figure><div class="orr-problem__copy"><h2 class="orr-h2 orr-reveal" style="--i:1">One agent <em>isn’t</em> a team.</h2><ol class="orr-numbered"><li class="orr-reveal" style="--i:2"><span class="orr-label orr-numbered__n">01</span><div><h3 class="orr-numbered__title">It loses the thread.</h3><p>Long jobs outgrow one context window. Halfway through, the plan is gone.</p></div></li><li class="orr-reveal" style="--i:3"><span class="orr-label orr-numbered__n">02</span><div><h3 class="orr-numbered__title">It does everything at one depth.</h3><p>Research, writing and review all get the same shallow pass.</p></div></li><li class="orr-reveal" style="--i:4"><span class="orr-label orr-numbered__n">03</span><div><h3 class="orr-numbered__title">Nobody checks its work.</h3><p>A single agent marks its own homework, and errors ship quietly.</p></div></li></ol></div></div></section><section id="orrery" class="orr-slide" data-tone="ink" data-state="future" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="3 of 10: The orrery"><div class="orr-slide-inner orr-orrery"><p class="orr-eyebrow orr-label orr-reveal" style="--i:0">03<!-- --> — <!-- -->The orrery</p><div class="orr-orrery__copy"><h2 class="orr-h2 orr-reveal" style="--i:1">Specialists on their own orbits, <em>kept in time.</em></h2><ol class="orr-legend" aria-label="Diagram key"><li data-lit="on"><span class="orr-label">The conductor</span><p>Reads the brief, splits the work and keeps time.</p></li><li data-lit="off"><span class="orr-label">Researchers</span><p>Close orbit. They gather context and check facts.</p></li><li data-lit="off"><span class="orr-label">Builders</span><p>Wide orbit. They write, code and produce.</p></li><li data-lit="off"><span class="orr-label">Shared memory</span><p>Every agent reads from and writes to one record.</p></li><li data-lit="off"><span class="orr-label">The hand-off</span><p>Work moves between agents, never dropped, always logged.</p></li></ol></div><div class="orr-orrery__diagram"><svg class="orr-orbit" viewBox="0 0 600 600" data-orbit-step="0" role="img" aria-label="Diagram: a conductor at the centre, two research agents on an inner orbit, three builder agents on an outer orbit, linked by shared memory, with a task passing between them."><circle class="orr-orbit__ring" data-show="off" cx="300" cy="300" r="128" pathLength="1"></circle><circle class="orr-orbit__ring orr-orbit__ring--outer" data-show="off" cx="300" cy="300" r="228" pathLength="1"></circle><g class="orr-orbit__links" data-show="off"><line x1="300" y1="300" x2="189.14874831559183" y2="236" pathLength="1"></line><line x1="300" y1="300" y2="527.132391164918" pathLength="1"></line><line x1="300" y1="300" x2="85.75008246081288" y2="222.01940732174756" pathLength="1"></line><line x1="410.85125168440817" y1="364" x2="474.658133031127" y2="153.44442499146905" pathLength="1"></line></g><g class="orr-orbit__spin orr-orbit__spin--inner"><circle class="orr-orbit__agent" data-show="off" cx="189.14874831559183" cy="236" r="11"></circle><circle class="orr-orbit__agent" data-show="off" cx="410.85125168440817" cy="364" r="11"></circle></g><g class="orr-orbit__spin orr-orbit__spin--outer"><circle class="orr-orbit__agent orr-orbit__agent--accent" data-show="off" cx="474.658133031127" cy="153.44442499146905" r="17"></circle><circle class="orr-orbit__agent" data-show="off" cx="280.1284906535339" cy="527.132391164918" 153.44442499146905" keyPoints="0;1" keyTimes="0;1" calcMode="linear"></animateMotion></circle></g></svg></div></div></section><section id="how" class="orr-slide" data-tone="bone" data-state="future" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="4 of 10: How it works"><div class="orr-slide-inner orr-how"><p class="orr-eyebrow orr-label orr-reveal" style="--i:0">04<!-- --> — <!-- -->How it works</p><h2 class="orr-h2 orr-how__title orr-reveal" style="--i:1">Three steps from brief <em>to finished work.</em></h2><ol class="orr-steps"><li class="orr-steps__item orr-reveal" style="--i:2"><span class="orr-steps__n">1</span><h3 class="orr-h3">Describe the work</h3><p>Write the outcome you want in plain language: the inputs, the bar for done, who signs off.</p></li><li class="orr-steps__item orr-reveal" style="--i:3"><span class="orr-steps__n">2</span><h3 class="orr-h3">Orrery assembles the team</h3><p>The conductor picks specialists, sets their orbits and wires them to one shared memory.</p></li><li class="orr-steps__item orr-reveal" style="--i:4"><span class="orr-steps__n">3</span><h3 class="orr-h3">Review, approve, ship</h3><p>Every hand-off is logged. You approve the result, or send it back around with a note.</p></li></ol></div></section><section id="use-cases" class="orr-slide" data-tone="bone" data-state="future" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="5 of 10: Use cases"><div class="orr-slide-inner orr-cases"><p class="orr-eyebrow orr-label orr-reveal" style="--i:0">05<!-- --> — <!-- -->Use cases</p><h2 class="orr-h2 orr-cases__title orr-reveal" style="--i:1">Where teams put <em>it to work.</em></h2><ul class="orr-cases__list"><li class="orr-cases__item orr-reveal" style="--i:2"><picture class="orr-art orr-art--card"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1200" height="896" alt="Index cards connected by fine ultramarine ink lines" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-asset="usecase-1" data-standalone-src="/templates/orrery/usecase-1-800.webp"/></picture><h3 class="orr-h3">Customer operations</h3><p>Triage, research and reply agents clear the queue overnight. People handle the conversations that need a person.</p></li><li class="orr-cases__item orr-reveal" style="--i:3"><picture class="orr-art orr-art--card"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1200" height="896" alt="A brass magnifying lens over a printed star chart" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-asset="usecase-2" data-standalone-src="/templates/orrery/usecase-2-800.webp"/></picture><h3 class="orr-h3">Research and analysis</h3><p>One agent gathers sources, another checks every claim, a third writes the brief your team actually reads.</p></li><li class="orr-cases__item orr-reveal" style="--i:4"><picture class="orr-art orr-art--card"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1200" height="896" alt="Brass clock gears on gridded drafting paper" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-asset="usecase-3" data-standalone-src="/templates/orrery/usecase-3-800.webp"/></picture><h3 class="orr-h3">Software engineering</h3><p>Planning, coding and review agents work the same ticket in turn, and every change arrives with its reasoning.</p></li></ul></div></section><section id="results" class="orr-slide" data-tone="bone" data-state="future" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="6 of 10: Results"><div class="orr-slide-inner orr-results"><p class="orr-eyebrow orr-label orr-reveal" style="--i:0">06<!-- --> — <!-- -->Results</p><h2 class="orr-h2 orr-results__title orr-reveal" style="--i:1">Measured in work <em>that ships.</em></h2><div class="orr-results__grid"><div class="orr-reveal" style="--i:2"><div class="orr-figure"><p class="orr-figure__value"><span class="orr-visually-hidden">4.2<!-- -->×</span><span aria-hidden="true">4.2<span class="orr-accent">×</span></span></p><p class="orr-figure__label">more tasks finished per week than single-agent setups</p></div></div><div class="orr-reveal" style="--i:3"><div class="orr-figure"><p class="orr-figure__value"><span class="orr-visually-hidden">63<!-- -->%</span><span aria-hidden="true">63<span class="orr-accent">%</span></span></p><p class="orr-figure__label">less time spent reviewing agent output</p></div></div><div class="orr-reveal" style="--i:4"><div class="orr-figure"><p class="orr-figure__value"><span class="orr-visually-hidden">99.6<!-- -->%</span><span aria-hidden="true">99.6<span class="orr-accent">%</span></span></p><p class="orr-figure__label">of hand-offs logged, replayable and attributable</p></div></div></div><p class="orr-label orr-results__note orr-reveal" style="--i:5">Median across 140 teams in the 2026 pilot programme</p></div></section><section id="quotes" class="orr-slide" data-tone="bone" data-state="future" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="7 of 10: Customers"><div class="orr-slide-inner orr-quotes"><p class="orr-eyebrow orr-label orr-reveal" style="--i:0">07<!-- --> — <!-- -->Customers</p><h2 class="orr-visually-hidden">What teams say</h2><figure class="orr-quotes__lead orr-reveal" style="--i:1"><picture class="orr-quotes__texture"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1024" height="1024" alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-asset="quote-texture" data-standalone-src="/templates/orrery/quote-texture-800.webp"/></picture><blockquote><p class="orr-quotes__big">“<!-- -->We stopped babysitting one agent and started managing a team. Our overnight queue is empty by 7 a.m.<!-- -->”</p></blockquote><figcaption><span class="orr-quotes__name">Mara Ilunga</span><span class="orr-label">Head of Support Operations, Northwind Freight</span></figcaption></figure><div class="orr-quotes__rest"><figure class="orr-quotes__small orr-reveal" style="--i:2"><blockquote><p>“<!-- -->Every change arrives with the reasoning attached. orr-security"><p class="orr-eyebrow orr-label orr-reveal" style="--i:0">09<!-- --> — <!-- -->Security</p><h2 class="orr-h2 orr-security__title orr-reveal" style="--i:1">Built for teams that <em>answer to auditors.</em></h2><ul class="orr-claims"><li class="orr-reveal" style="--i:2"><h3 class="orr-claims__title">SOC 2 Type II</h3><p>Audited annually. Reports available under NDA.</p></li><li class="orr-reveal" style="--i:3"><h3 class="orr-claims__title">Your region, your data</h3><p>Run in the EU, US or APAC. Nothing leaves it.</p></li><li class="orr-reveal" style="--i:4"><h3 class="orr-claims__title">Every hand-off logged</h3><p>Who did what, with which inputs, and when. Replayable.</p></li><li class="orr-reveal" style="--i:5"><h3 class="orr-claims__title">Human approval gates</h3><p>Agents pause for sign-off on anything you mark sensitive.</p></li><li class="orr-reveal" style="--i:6"><h3 class="orr-claims__title">No training on your work</h3><p>Your prompts and outputs are never used to train models.</p></li><li class="orr-reveal" style="--i:7"><h3 class="orr-claims__title">SSO and SCIM</h3><p>Provision and revoke access from your identity provider.</p></li></ul><picture class="orr-security__texture orr-reveal"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1376" height="768" alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-asset="security-texture" data-standalone-src="/templates/orrery/security-texture-800.webp"/></picture></div></section><section id="cta" class="orr-slide" data-tone="bone" data-state="future" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="10 of 10: Book a demo"><div class="orr-slide-inner orr-cta"><p class="orr-eyebrow orr-label orr-reveal" style="--i:0">10<!-- --> — <!-- -->Book a demo</p><div class="orr-cta__copy"><h2 class="orr-display orr-cta__title orr-reveal" style="--i:1">Put your agents <em>in orbit.</em></h2><p class="orr-lead orr-reveal" style="--i:2">A 30-minute call with an engineer.
